WEBSITE PRIVACY

A little clarity.

This page covers the Kokonut website. It does not replace privacy information for SideQuest, Haste or Revisen, which have their own accounts, storage and services.

Browsing the website

The website code does not use analytics, advertising trackers, sign-up forms, cookies or local storage. It does not request your location, camera, microphone or contacts. Motion preferences last for the current page visit only.

Hosting and network providers may process ordinary technical request information, including IP addresses, requested URLs and browser information, to serve and protect the site. Fonts, 3D models, scripts and images are served with the website.

Downloading an app

APK download buttons lead to public files hosted by GitHub. GitHub processes the request under its own privacy terms. Downloading a file does not create an app account. When you open an app, its own permissions and data handling apply.

Your device

The website checks your browser’s device information locally to display installation guidance for iPhone and iPad visitors. That check is not sent to an analytics service. Copy buttons write to the clipboard only when you press them. Interactive 3D is optional: the project artwork and links also work without it.
